title: LibScript Live Installer Execution Plan
description: Declarative execution plan specification for msi-rs live-CD/live-USB installers

plan_version.description: Semantic version of the live installer plan format

target_disk.description: Target storage drive discovery and geometry configuration

device.description: Block device path or disk number to partition and format

scheme.description: Partition table format (gpt for modern UEFI, mbr for legacy BIOS, vtoc for illumos, gpt-dual-os for concurrent dual boot, gpt-multiboot / mbr-multiboot for triple-boot Linux + FreeBSD + illumos)

wipe_existing.description: Whether to sanitize and wipe existing partition headers before provisioning

swap_size_mib.description: Size in megabytes allocated for swap partition (0 for no swap)

partitions.description: Explicit user-configured partition layout specification from visual editor

partition_number.description: 1-based index of the partition on disk

role.description: Partition role designation for MBR partition schemes

type_guid.description: Standardized GPT partition type GUID or MBR type hex code

size_mib.description: Size of the partition in megabytes or 0 for remaining space

action.description: Whether to destructively format or non-destructively reuse partition data

bootable.description: Mark partition with active bootable flag bit

distribution.description: Primary base operating system deployment specification

flavor.description: Specific distribution variant (e.g. alpine, debian, rocky, lfs, default)

filesystem.description: Root filesystem formatter or pool type

pool_name.description: ZFS root pool identifier when filesystem is zfs

concurrent_distributions.description: Optional secondary operating systems deployed concurrently onto separate partitions (e.g. Linux + FreeBSD dual-boot)

items.description: Secondary operating system distribution target specification

family.description: Kernel family for secondary co-installed OS

target_partition.description: Dedicated partition block path for secondary OS

mode.description: Interaction mode for live installer execution

workloads.description: List of preloaded LibScript stacks to deploy into target root (empty for clean base)

items.description: Name of the workload to stage (e.g. openedx, wordpress, minimal, none)

selected_components.description: Fine-grained list of individual packages selected dynamically from LibScript catalog (e.g. nginx, odoo, postgres)

items.description: Individual component identifier from LibScript catalog

hostname.description: Host name assigned to the installed machine

dhcp.description: Enable automated DHCP on primary network interface
